## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Paṭisambhidākathā* (Kv 5.5) is a debate located in the fifth chapter (*vagga*) of the *Kathāvatthu*, the fifth treatise of the canonical Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The title of the text pertains to the doctrinal category of the analytical knowledges or discriminations (*paṭisambhidā*). Modern scholars note that the fourfold classification of *paṭisambhidā* (Sanskrit *pratisamvid*)—consisting of discrimination of meaning (*attha*), teachings or phenomena (*dhamma*), language (*nirutti*), and perspicuity (*paṭibhāna*)—is virtually absent from the earlier strata of the Pali sūtras, finding systematic treatment only in later canonical and Abhidhamma texts such as the *Kathāvatthu*, *Vibhaṅga*, and *Niddesa* [Potter 1996].

No individual translations in English are identified by specific titles on SuttaCentral, though one modern translation is indexed [SuttaCentral]. The text has no curated external parallels recorded by SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral]. However, algorithmic text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus indicates substantial internal reuse across the Abhidhamma Piṭaka, identifying 63 matching passages shared across nine other Pali works [DharmaNexus]. Within the *Kathāvatthu*, it shares repetitive debate formulations with chapters such as the *Viparītakathā* (Kv 5.3), *Vacībhedakathā* (Kv 2.5), *Sabbamatthītikathā* (Kv 1.6), *Ñāṇakathā* (Kv 20.2), *Sabbamidaṁkammatotikathā* (Kv 17.3), and the subsequent *Sammutiñāṇakathā* (Kv 5.6) [DharmaNexus]. Outside the *Kathāvatthu*, DharmaNexus aligns passages with the *Piṭṭhiduka* of the *Paṭṭhāna* (Patthana 2.13), the *Mūlavāraniddesa* of the *Yamaka* (Ya 1.2.1), and the *Paṭisambhidāmagga-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language matches meeting significance thresholds are detected [DharmaNexus].
